concerns: The dataset pipeline augments images before the 8:1:1 train/validation/test split, creating a substantial risk of near-duplicate leakage into the test set and undermining the reported accuracy and generalization claims.

Evaluation is confined to a single dam site dataset with no independent external benchmark or cross-site validation, so the claimed robustness and deployability across diverse real-world scenarios are not established.
The manuscript reports no statistical uncertainty, repeated-run variance, or significance testing for the small performance margins over strong baselines such as YOLOv8n and YOLO11n.
scholarly_quality.concise_summary: While the architectural concepts for lightweight detection are reasonable, augmenting the raw images from 1,000 to 4,000 before splitting them 8:1:1 into train, validation, and test sets introduces near-duplicate leakage into the test set. This creates high scientific uncertainty regarding whether the reported performance reflects genuine generalization or memorization of augmented pairs.

missing_information: No reproducible review or selection methodology was detected.

blocking_reasons: The dataset pipeline augments images before the 8:1:1 train/validation/test split, creating a substantial risk of near-duplicate leakage into the test set and undermining the reported accuracy and generalization claims.

Evaluation is confined to a single dam site dataset with no independent external benchmark or cross-site validation, so the claimed robustness and deployability across diverse real-world scenarios are not established.
The manuscript reports no statistical uncertainty, repeated-run variance, or significance testing for the small performance margins over strong baselines such as YOLOv8n and YOLO11n.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: No evaluator-independent external benchmark or separately calibrated measurement is reported; the headline outcome rests on standard mAP metrics against human-annotated test labels.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Standard mAP50 and mAP50:95 computed against human-annotated ground-truth test labels.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Supervised training loss for bounding box regression and classification optimized via Adam on the augmented dam crack training set.

primary.claim_evidence_alignment: Claims of high detection accuracy (97.5% mAP50) and robust generalization across complex engineering scenarios are not solidly supported due to potential data leakage from pre-split augmentation and reliance on a single geographic location.
primary.evaluation_assessment: The model is evaluated against standard object detection baselines on a single dam site dataset using standard metrics (mAP, GFLOPs, parameters, latency). Because dataset augmentation preceded the train/validation/test split, test images likely contain augmented duplicates of training samples, undermining the validity of the reported high accuracy.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Standard supervised training and evaluation using separate loss functions and mAP benchmarks; evaluation is not derived from a learned proxy evaluator.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Standard mean Average Precision (mAP50 and mAP50:95) computed against human-annotated ground-truth test labels.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Supervised training loss (bounding box regression and object classification) optimized via Adam on the augmented dam crack training set.

primary.limitations: The authors acknowledge sensitivity to complex environmental conditions and illumination changes, but fail to address the methodological flaw of augmenting the dataset prior to random train/val/test partitioning.
primary.method_assessment: The architectural modifications adapt existing YOLO paradigms through depthwise separable convolutions, StarNet blocks, and shared detection heads. However, the data preparation pipeline applies image augmentation before splitting into train, validation, and test subsets (4000 samples generated and then partitioned 8:1:1), creating a substantial risk of data leakage across splits.
primary.quality_rationale: While the architectural concepts for lightweight detection are reasonable, augmenting the raw images from 1,000 to 4,000 before splitting them 8:1:1 into train, validation, and test sets introduces near-duplicate leakage into the test set. This creates high scientific uncertainty regarding whether the reported performance reflects genuine generalization or memorization of augmented pairs.
primary.scoped_contribution: DAM-YOLO is a lightweight object detector tailored for dam crack detection, integrating a StarNet-s050 backbone, a C3k2 Star feature fusion neck, and a Detect LSCD detection head.

scholarly_quality.rationale: While the architectural concepts for lightweight detection are reasonable, augmenting the raw images from 1,000 to 4,000 before splitting them 8:1:1 into train, validation, and test sets introduces near-duplicate leakage into the test set. This creates high scientific uncertainty regarding whether the reported performance reflects genuine generalization or memorization of augmented pairs.
scholarly_quality.uncertainty: The authors acknowledge sensitivity to complex environmental conditions and illumination changes, but fail to address the methodological flaw of augmenting the dataset prior to random train/val/test partitioning.

limitations_or_uncertainty.value: Structured research-card claims use title, abstract/summary, metadata, screening rules, and curation. A separate scholarly-quality assessment used bounded full-text excerpts, but unsupported claim, method, or evidence fields remain unextracted.
